subject: Request: evidence for unbilled third-party usage - DataWave Sept settlement
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace Billing <mp-billing@amazonaws.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Sep 2029 08:14:22 -0700
Subject: Request: evidence for unbilled third-party usage - DataWave Sept settlement

Hi team,

We’re preparing the September settlement reconciliation for DataWave Ltd (related account DW-2029-EXP-17) and we’ve surfaced ~€28k of marketplace-stamped usage that did not appear on the DataWave-paid invoice. AWS’s marketplace ledger shows those tokens attributed to a redirected seller entity in our marketplace mapping. Before we issue an adjustment, AWS Marketplace, can you confirm the authoritative evidence you have that ties these specific usage timestamps to the seller entity (seller id / marketplace sku / listing id)?

What we need from your side: 
- The per-hour usage export for 2029-09-01 to 2029-09-30 (marketplace-stamped timestamps + usage id)
- Any seller-side entity id mapping you used to attribute those lines
- A brief note on why those lines would not have been billed to DataWave’s invoice (if available)

Cc’ing our finance and marketplace operations (Marissa, Jonas) so they have visibility. We will attach our own raw usage export and our entity mapping in a follow-up but wanted to get AWS’s primary evidence first.

Thanks,

Irene Choi
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132

Attachments: none (sending initial request)

From: AWS Marketplace Billing <mp-billing@amazonaws.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: DataWave Accounts <accounts@datawave.co.uk>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Sep 2029 11:02:10 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for unbilled third-party usage - DataWave Sept settlement

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks for the heads up — we pulled the ledger slice for DataWave and the related seller IDs. Summary: the lines you reference are associated with seller_id SLR-92F and listing_id LST-8853; those were routed under a legacy partner aggregation flow and therefore were excluded from the DataWave invoice run in our system.

We can provide: 
- A signed CSV extract (marketplace_usage_export.csv) that includes marketplace_timestamp, usage_id, seller_id, listing_id, and gross_amount.
- An export of our seller-to-entity mapping table for that month.

Two quick asks from our side to speed reconciliation: 
1) Please send your entity mapping workbook that shows DataWave's legal entities / tax IDs so we can run a join and confirm attribution.
2) Confirm if you want us to issue a credit memo to DataWave or if Redwood will absorb a temporary adjustment while you coordinate remapping on your side.

I’ll attach the CSV and mapping in a secure link; if you prefer we can also push the files to the Drive folder you specify.

Best,

Samir Patel
Marketplace Billing Operations
AWS Marketplace Billing
mp-billing@amazonaws.com

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Sep 2029 12:36:55 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: evidence for unbilled third-party usage - DataWave Sept settlement

Marissa / Jonas — forwarding AWS’s reply.

I’ve attached our exported raw usage for Sept (usage_export_2029-09.csv) and our internal entity mapping workbook (entity_mapping_dw.xlsx). Key points:
- The lines AWS attributes to SLR-92F map in our ingest to a deprecated DataWave sub-entity (DW-EU-3) that should have been consolidated onto DataWave’s primary invoice.
- We’re evaluating whether the mismatch originated from a seller-merge event in July where the legacy seller id was not linked to the new legal entity.

As discussed offline, I’d prefer we ask AWS to issue a provisional credit memo to DataWave (copy to accounts@datawave.co.uk) and we’ll coordinate the permanent correction via a remapping request. This avoids delaying DataWave’s payment and holds the gross/net reconciliation transparent.

Attachments: usage_export_2029-09.csv, entity_mapping_dw.xlsx

Irene

> On Mon, 30 Sep 2029 at 11:02 AM Samir Patel <mp-billing@amazonaws.com> wrote:

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace Billing <mp-billing@amazonaws.com>, DataWave Accounts <accounts@datawave.co.uk>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Sep 2029 15:42:03 -0700
Subject: Action: provisional credit + evidence bundle for DataWave Sept settlement (DW-2029-EXP-17)

Hi Samir / DataWave team — looping in Redwood finance. Per Irene’s request and AWS’s confirmation, we’re requesting a provisional credit memo for the €28,014.72 of marketplace usage that was omitted from DataWave’s invoice due to legacy seller routing (seller_id SLR-92F).

Action items and attachments: 
- AWS Marketplace to issue a provisional credit memo to DataWave: CW-2029-09-PLAT-028014.72 (please confirm expected created date and credit reference).
- I’ve attached the reconciled export and a short reconciliation PDF that highlights the affected usage rows: payout_reconciliation_notes.pdf (see lines 14–29).
- Permanent fix: Redwood will submit an entity remapping request to AWS (ticket: HS-123456789) with the legal entity and tax IDs; Jonas will own the remapping packet.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExampleDriveLink (files: usage_export_2029-09.csv, entity_mapping_dw.xlsx, payout_reconciliation_notes.pdf)

Please confirm when the provisional credit is issued and send the credit memo PDF to accounts@datawave.co.uk and finance@redwood.com.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
